summary: Parked-up kerb on a steep Mitre Street climb; houses 12-15 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Apartments 12 m and detached houses 15 m away on the same side; apartments opposite 23 m and more.
drivers.access_and_room: Public street with a parking lane where cars park; room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, near a junction at the south end.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, but 2P resident-permit signs apply on weekdays.

flags: Dwellings 12-15 m away on the same side
Steep: about 6% here, 28% max further on, mean 15%
sun_shade: Tree canopy from the east side; open to the west.
